additional_info.subject: ID0399338-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S9 170004102] Outlet2 out of order. CRM:00642001928
additional_info.body:
Hello Siro,
Hope you are doing well.
We have received a case from an end customer regarding Outlet 2 being out of order. Upon reviewing the logs, we identified a communication loss between SECC and DC2. Also, we have an analysis added in timeline. Please find the attached screenshot for your reference.
After checking via SSH access, we were unable to access ecog and need to arrange a site visit as soon as possible.
We recommend bringing the SECC and a LAN cable when you visit the site. Please note that rebooting the charger may cause it to enter failsafe mode.
Error 1: "SECC_KF11_GenData_MB_Problem"
Check the SECC2300 for proper electrical connections.
Verify the LAN connection between SECC2300 and PLC.
Restart the SECC2300 by unplugging and replugging the J1 connector (located at the top left front).
Error 2: "SECC_DC2_MB_Problem_KF11"
Ensure the SECC2300 of the dispenser is available and connected.
Restart the SECC.
Please perform this activity and let us know the outcome. We will wait for your feedback.

additional_info.subject: Semih
additional_info.body:
The issue was that the fastshutdown was failing and then the outlets were unavailable caused by this. Seems like there is a bug on 6.0.3 for that i connected with Joao Cardoso.  I updated the charger to 6.0.3 and changed some wrong parameters in the configuration. Now Charger is green and working
the issue is forwoarded to RnD via EVC3-8116 as the converter grouping is not working properly
